method: Microsoft Word 16.0 hidden/read-only native PDF export, then direct visual inspection of each rendered page image
scope: All 23 pages inspected at 118.8 dpi; reviewed text, tables, page boundaries, clipping, overlap, density, and readability. The three pages with content-text changes are 8, 22, and 23. No clipping, overlap, cut-off, or unreadable table/text was observed.
baseline_comparison: R07-to-R08 raster pixel equality is inconclusive because the R07 rasterizer/version settings were not recorded; the pixel-diff JSON is preserved as diagnostic evidence only. It does not indicate that all pages had layout defects. R08 native render was directly inspected.
